event.description: Tie the unused PAD row to digit zero
event.proposal: family: token representation; current retained incumbent is 2884 parameters at 99.9900%, a +0.99 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0002, reversed operand token order at 5056/99.98%; same-family failed result: attempt-0053, the repaired 14-row plus zero-PAD table at 2870/95.64% (attempt-0052 was its MPS implementation error); prior attempts in this family: 5. Hypothesis: zeroing PAD changed output calibration even though PAD is unused, so retain a learned PAD logit by tying its row to the digit-zero vector while still removing one independent row. The materialized tied table remains 15-way and saves 14 parameters for 2870 total. This is more informative than fixing BOS or EOS because it preserves a learned competing PAD direction without altering active control tokens; the nearest untested alternative is tying PAD to EOS, which would couple an unused output to the active stopping symbol. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, ff23, rank8 positions, affine-free block pre-norms, final learned scale without bias, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2884 parameters.
